restaurants.name: Britto's Restaurant
restaurants.description: A legendary beach shack in Baga known for its lively music, sunset views, and authentic Goan seafood.

restaurants.name: Sunset Grill
restaurants.must_try: Grilled Fish, Shrimp and Prawn Fry
restaurants.description: An open-air dining option offering amazing seafood with beautiful views of the sea.

restaurants.name: Shiva Valley Beach Shack
restaurants.description: Known as a temple of trance, this shack offers simple, tasty street food and local Goan snacks.

restaurants.name: Gunpowder
restaurants.must_try: Kerala Beef Fry, Malabar Parotta, Pandhi Curry
restaurants.description: Set in a beautiful heritage garden in Assagao, serving incredibly flavorful home-style coastal food.

restaurants.name: Fisherman's Wharf
restaurants.description: A riverside dining experience in Cavelossim celebrating Goan culture and fresh catches.

restaurants.name: Thalassa
restaurants.description: Famous clifftop restaurant in Siolim offering breathtaking sunset views over the river and Greek dance performances.

nearby_places.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
nearby_places.description: A majestic four-tiered waterfall on the Mandovi River, surrounded by deciduous forests with rich biodiversity.

nearby_places.name: Bondla Wildlife Sanctuary
nearby_places.description: A lush green sanctuary ideal for eco-tourism, featuring a miniature zoo, deer park, and botanical gardens.
nearby_places.best_time: Late morning to early afternoon (10:00 AM - 2:00 PM)

nearby_places.name: Arambol Beach
nearby_places.description: A pristine beach in North Goa famous for its bohemian vibe, sweet water lake, and daily drum circles at sunset.

nearby_places.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
nearby_places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site holding the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, boasting beautiful baroque architecture.

nearby_places.name: Anjuna Flea Market
nearby_places.description: A vibrant beachside flea market offering handicrafts, spices, clothes, and local art, held every Wednesday.

restaurants.name: Murugan Idli Shop
restaurants.description: An iconic local eatery famous for its soft idlis, delicious variety of chutneys, and filter coffee.

restaurants.name: Annalakshmi Restaurant
restaurants.description: A unique cultural restaurant with antique wood carvings, serving traditional home-cooked vegetarian meals.

restaurants.name: Southern Spice (Taj Coromandel)
restaurants.description: An award-winning restaurant offering a luxurious journey through the culinary heritage of South India's four states.

nearby_places.name: Marina Beach
nearby_places.description: The longest natural urban beach in the country, featuring a vibrant promenade, lighthouses, and local food stalls.

nearby_places.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
nearby_places.description: A 7th-century temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, showcasing classical Dravidian architecture with a towering colorful Gopuram.

nearby_places.name: Guindy National Park
nearby_places.description: One of the very few national parks situated inside a city, home to blackbucks, spotted deer, and jackals.

restaurants.name: Murugan Idli Shop (Madurai Branch)
restaurants.must_try: Podi Idli, Onion Uttapam, Filter Coffee
restaurants.description: The original birth city of the famous chain. Serves iconic fluffy idlis on banana leaves with spicy chutneys.

restaurants.name: Jigarthanda Famous Shop
restaurants.description: Madurai's most famous sweet drink shop, serving a refreshing mixture of milk, almond gum, sarsaparilla syrup, and ice cream.

restaurants.name: Amma Mess
restaurants.must_try: Mutton Kola Urundai, Bone Marrow Omelette
restaurants.description: A legendary culinary landmark in Madurai known for its innovative and highly spiced traditional non-veg dishes.

nearby_places.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
nearby_places.description: A historic Hindu temple on the southern bank of the Vaigai River, famous for its 14 gopurams and the Hall of a Thousand Pillars.
nearby_places.best_time: Morning (6:00 AM - 9:00 AM) or Night (7:00 PM - 9:00 PM)

nearby_places.name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace
nearby_places.description: A 17th-century palace built by King Thirumalai Nayak, boasting a fusion of Italian and Rajput architectural styles.
nearby_places.best_time: Afternoon (1:00 PM - 4:00 PM) for the interior pillars, and evening for the light & sound show.

restaurants.name: Shinkows Chinese Restaurant
restaurants.description: One of Ooty's oldest eateries run by a Chinese-origin family, serving comforting classic Indo-Chinese food in a vintage setting.

restaurants.name: Place to Bee
restaurants.description: A cozy cafe focusing on eco-tourism and slow food, promoting local forest honey and fresh organic local ingredients.

restaurants.name: Earl's Secret (at King's Cliff)
restaurants.description: Set inside a beautiful glasshouse looking over sprawling lawns and hills, offering a romantic colonial dining ambiance.

nearby_places.name: Ooty Botanical Gardens
nearby_places.description: Sprawling gardens laid out in 1848, containing a fossil tree trunk estimated to be 20 million years old and thousands of exotic plant species.

nearby_places.name: Doddabetta Peak
nearby_places.description: The highest mountain in the Nilgiri Hills at 2,637 meters, offering spectacular panoramic vistas of the valley.
nearby_places.best_time: Early morning (7:00 AM - 9:30 AM) before fog rolls in

nearby_places.name: Pykara Lake and Waterfalls
nearby_places.description: A scenic lake formed by Pykara dam with boating facilities, surrounded by dense pine forests and rolling shola grass hills.
